3.name: Oath of Glory Spells
3.notes:
You always have certain spells prepared according to the Oath of Glory Spells table.

3rd: Guiding Bolt, Heroism
5th: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon
9th: Haste, Protection from Energy
13th: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement
17th: Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence

3.name: Inspiring Smite
3.notes: Immediately after casting Divine Smite, expend one use of Channel Divinity to distribute Temporary Hit Points among creatures of your choice within 30 feet. Total THP equals 2d8 + your Paladin level, divided among chosen creatures as you wish.

3.name: Peerless Athlete
3.notes: As a Bonus Action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to enhance your athleticism for 1 hour. You gain Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your Long and High Jump distances increase by 10 feet (still requiring movement).

7.name: Aura of Alacrity
7.notes:
Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

Additionally, whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, their Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

15.name: Glorious Defense
15.notes:
When you or a creature within 10 feet is hit by an attack, you may take a Reaction to grant a bonus to the target's AC equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), potentially causing the attack to miss.

If the attack misses, you may immediately make a weapon attack against the attacker as part of the same Reaction, provided they are within your weapon’s range.

Usable a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses after a Long Rest.

20.name: Living Legend
20.notes:
As a Bonus Action, empower yourself for 10 minutes. Usable once per Long Rest or restored by expending a level 5 spell slot.

Charismatic. You have Advantage on all Charisma checks.

Saving Throw Reroll. When you fail a saving throw, you may take a Reaction to reroll it, using the new result.

Unerring Strike. Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, you may choose for that attack to hit instead.
